scenarios.title: A changeling is every creature type
decisions: No actions; the stable battlefield is evaluated.

variants.label: changeling
variants.expected: Avian Changeling has every creature type, including Goblin. Goblin King's bonus applies: Avian Changeling is 3/3 with flying and mountainwalk.

variants.label: non_goblin
variants.delta: A controls Grizzly Bears instead of Avian Changeling.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a Bear, not a Goblin, so Goblin King's bonus does not apply. Grizzly Bears is 2/2 with no mountainwalk.
